topic: auto judges only isolated roots, not other spaces' login folders (security audit medium)
detail: D-61: auto writes rules 'only when another isolated space exists whose folders they would deny'. A policy with one isolated job and a personal or public space that names its own gh_config_dir (stored with --insecure-storage) or claude_config_dir gives the job's checkouts no rules, so nothing denies its sessions those folders or <data>/spaces/.orch (users' settings backups and the list of every space's checkouts). Options: (a) also write rules when the rules would deny another space's login folder; (b) always write them while .orch holds anything; (c) keep D-61's text and document it (done in docs/internals/install.md Limits). Blocks SP-046 (DOD-6) until decided.
resolution: Settled by the user on 2026-11-14 as D-69; implemented by the SP-046 follow-up lane.
